Package index

Spectral Vegetation Indices & Land Cover Masks

Functions to calculate multispectral vegetation vigor, canopy chlorophyll, moisture accumulation, and binary bare soil substrate masks.

d4h_ndvi()
Normalized Difference Vegetation Index (NDVI)
d4h_msavi2()
Modified Soil-Adjusted Vegetation Index 2 (MSAVI2)
d4h_savi()
Soil-Adjusted Vegetation Index (SAVI)
d4h_bare_soil()
Bare Soil Mask
d4h_vari()
Visible Atmospherically Resistant Index (VARI)
d4h_ndre()
Normalized Difference Red Edge Index (NDRE)
d4h_gndvi()
Green Normalized Difference Vegetation Index (GNDVI)
d4h_ndwi()
Normalized Difference Water Index (NDWI)
d4h_evi()
Enhanced Vegetation Index (EVI)
d4h_dvi()
Difference Vegetation Index (DVI)
d4h_ctvi()
Corrected Transformed Vegetation Index (CTVI)

Micro-Terrain Topography & Hydrology

Elevation derivatives and terrain moisture modeling from UAV Digital Elevation Models (DEM/DSM).

d4h_slope()
Topographic Slope
d4h_twi()
Topographic Wetness Index (TWI)

Eco-Epidemiological Spatial Indices

Spatial modeling of localized vector-borne disease transmission factors, solid waste micro-accumulation, and hydric breeding suitability.

d4h_imsr()
Synthetic Materials Risk Index (IMSR)
d4h_irhe()
Spectral Water Retention Index (IRHE)
d4h_irih()
Human Interface Roughness Index (IRIH)
d4h_irts()
Thermal Refuge and Shade Index (IRTS)
d4h_iev()
Vulnerability Stagnation Indicator (IEV)
d4h_iec()
Breeding Site Stratification Index (IEC)
d4h_ifeb()
Fragmentation and Edge Effect Index (IFEB)
d4h_iead()
Clearing Stagnation Index (IEAD)

Feature Segmentation & Spatial Proximity to Water

Automated object segmentation of water bodies and residential building footprints from ultra-high resolution RGB imagery, with Euclidean distance to water modeling.

d4h_segment_water()
Segment Water Bodies and Surface Moisture Pools
d4h_segment_buildings()
Segment House Roofs and Building Footprints
d4h_distance_to_water()
Calculate Distance and Proximity to Water Sources
d4h_distance_to_risk()
Calculate Distance and Vulnerability Risk to Water Sources
d4h_raster_distance()
Continuous Euclidean Distance Raster from Risk Sources

Spatial Grids & Zonation

Operational surveillance grids (hexagons/squares), grid-level distance-to-water risk modeling, land cover percentage composition, and zonal summary statistics extraction.

d4h_hex_grid()
Generate Hexagonal Surveillance Grid
d4h_grid_distance_to_water()
Spatial Grid Proximity and Exposure Modeling to Water Bodies
d4h_grid_composition()
Grid-Level Land Cover Percentage Composition and Feature Segmentation
d4h_summarize_grid()
Summarize Raster Indicator by Spatial Grid
d4h_summarize_general()
Summarize Raster Indicator for the General Mosaic Footprint
d4h_raster_general()
Convert Raster Indicator to General Homogeneous Mosaic
d4h_summarize_global() d4h_global_summary()
Global Statistical Summary of Raster Indicators

Interactive Mapping & Cartography

Interactive swipe comparison viewers with dynamic contrast tuning, buffer-targeted focal index rendering with house overlays, and static publication-quality ggplot2 cartography.

d4h_mapview_swipe()
Interactive Side-by-Side Raster Swipe Viewer
d4h_indicator_buffer()
Targeted Focal Indicator Analysis and Plotting around House Buffers
d4h_plot()
Unified Cartographic and Interactive Visualization

Executive Reporting & Excel Export

Multi-moment statistical summaries, Tukey outlier diagnostics, and direct multi-sheet Excel (.xlsx) workbook export.

d4h_executive_summary() d4h_report()
Executive Summary of Micro-Environmental and Epidemiological Indicators
d4h_export_summary()
Export Executive Summary to Multi-Sheet Excel File
